children: Stock index futures were lower on Thursday after U.S. equities closed deep in the red on Wednesday as Treasury yields spiked and markets priced in further rate hikes in the year.
Here are the five news items investors should watch:
F-35 components routed to Hong Kong:
UPS mistakenly routed an Australian F-35 cockpit canopy and weapons-bay door to Hong Kong while transporting the Lockheed Martin
components to the U.S. for

and possible repair or disposal, Bloomberg News reported. The parts were coated with radar-absorbing material designed to reduce the aircraft's radar signature and were subsequently taken into Chinese government custody, raising supply chain security concerns.
Google nears Gemini 4 launch:

Google (GOOG, GOOGL) is nearing the launch of its next-generation Gemini 4 AI model, DeepMind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu said Wednesday at The Information's AI Agenda Live Summit. The development comes as the
works to compete with Anthropic
and OpenAI
, while Meta
has gained traction with its AI products.
Federal judge orders press access restored:
A federal judge ordered President Donald Trump to temporarily restore White House press credentials for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico. Judge Timothy Kelly said the
of reporters' press badges was likely carried out without constitutionally adequate due process.
Anthropic AI discovery pressures gene-editing stocks:
Gene-editing companies traded lower Wednesday after Anthropic
said its Claude AI model had “autonomously discovered” a new enzyme system similar to the gene-editing tool CRISPR. Beam Therapeutics
, CRISPR Therapeutics
, Intellia Therapeutics
, Prime Medicine
, Q32 Bio
, and LENZ Therapeutics
were among the notable decliners.
Meta unveils handheld AI device:
Meta Platforms

introduced a small handheld AI device called Meta Charm at its Connect event Wednesday, extending the company's hardware push beyond smart glasses. The roughly Apple AirPods-case-sized device has an approximately 2-inch OLED touchscreen and built-in 5G, with shipments expected in December; Meta has not disclosed pricing.
